details:
I'm getting really sick and tired of how much moderation gets abused by instance moderators. I've gotten kicked from instances more in this last year than I ever have in my entire time playing this game almost exclusively by overzealous instance moderators. It's worse than Reddit mods.

Public instances now apparently have moderation tools similar to group instances but unfortunately that means they have even less accountability.

Kicks should be kicks, not several hour bans. It used to be 30 minutes and that was better but it should be more inline with Discord. If you go on Discord, Minecraft, Teamspeak, or any other platform with moderation tools, a kick is a kick. The user can rejoin immediately after.

But on VRC they function as a ban that a moderator can use whenever they want as much as they want. And because you have no way of knowing who banned / kicked you, there's no accountability for the moderator's actions. The user that got kicked should know why they got kicked and by who.

If you join a group instance, the group rules should automatically pop up when you join them.

World creators should not be able to be kicked from their own world. This is absolutely insane that this can even happen. It's happened to me already and I wasn't even saying anything.

Currently going into a group instance feels like walking on egg shells constantly. I end up having to choose between having fun and being careful about every thing that I do or else I get kicked. (For example, I once set my avatar's height "too tall" and within 5 seconds, I had an instance moderator on my case about it.)

Perhaps there could be a system that allows users to let other users know when a group abuses their power often so they can choose to avoid them. Currently I avoid group publics whenever possible because of the hostile environment it creates.

Bar worlds are probably the worst offenders. Instead of creating an 18+ instance, they set up booths, ask for personal information, and kick you if you don't tell them. The fact that it's become so normalized within the community is genuinely baffling and terrifying. It is not normal behaviour.

When I would go to the Black Cat, when someone was pretending to work at the front desk, it was whimsical and I'd go along with the bit because I know that person would be fun. But now it's more likely they're an instance moderator and I brace for the worst. It's sucked the whimsy out of the game.

The amount of times I've been sitting in an instance, someone will come up to me, be a jerk, get blocked, and then I get kicked because the person I just blocked was an instance moderator is insane. It truly truly sucks. And then because a kick is a ban, I can't join my friends in that instance for several hours. I can shoot my friend a DM on Discord but it's unlikely that 10 people will hop instances for one person.
title: Instance moderators have too much power. Kicks should be kicks, not bans.
